removal_dependencies.card: Also suppress reconstructed turn counters whose completeness depends on replay/modifier semantics; keep card type and current payable resources.
removal_dependencies.powers: Also suppress reconstructed turn counters and power-owned selection effect descriptors. Detached played-power descriptions/counts are excluded in every configuration, independently of this ablation.
removal_dependencies.items: Also suppress reconstructed turn counters, item-owned selection descriptors and history phase-observation flags affected by extra-turn relics.
removal_dependencies.intent: Suppress current pressure-derived threat summaries; retain historical profiles as a separate feature family.
removal_dependencies.turn_context: Suppress duplicated turn/play item counters and public power counters that directly encode those counts.
removal_dependencies.piles: Retain counts and currently offered/source cards needed to identify legal selection operands.

limits: Structured mechanics cover an explicit subset. Unknown mechanics are distinguishable from absent effects; description-complete flags are conservative.
Feature removals with dependent paths are coupled interventions, not proof of the isolated named field's causal value.
Reference algorithms and private observation fields are not imported. Our own headless rules and public contracts remain authoritative.
